$Comment: The Cursed Crypt kit, piece Cursed_Rooms_Hall: every prefab under Dungeon.Cursed_Crypt.Cursed.Rooms.Hall, 1 interchangeable variant.

Imported from vanilla's cave-node graph Dungeons/Dungeon_Cursed_Crypt (2 nodes use this pool) by tools/rooms/import_kit.py. Re-run the importer when Hytale changes the kit instead of editing this file.
Each door is a doorway vanilla's graph joins to another piece; a door only meets a door of its own Kind, and one left open takes a Cap room of that Kind.
Box covers every variant except 364 blocks standing one block proud of a doorway's wall, left out so the doorway sits on the Box's face.
Vanilla pastes these pieces into solid rock, so Fill (Rock_Stone) fills the cells a piece leaves unlisted inside its Box.
